prompt: Write a Go program that generates a new level3.tscn with 4 rooms connected in a ring loop. Each room should have some platforms inside. Include both boundary and background tiles. Output to scenes/levels/level3.tscn using terrain_tileset.tres.

assertions.text: Output .tscn has correct format: [gd_scene format=4], TileMapLayer node, PackedByteArray, correct tileset ext_resource
Map has 4 distinct rooms carved from the solid grid
All rooms connect to at least 2 others forming a ring (no dead ends)
Encoder uses both source_id=0 (boundary) and source_id=3 (background)
Rooms have interior platforms (fill calls inside carved areas)
